messages:
micah: heads-up: after last night's idp cert rotate we started getting SCIM 400s and a few tenants lost RBAC roles. errors show non-printable chars in groups attr.
jen: can you paste a sanitized snippet?
micah: from gateway logs (redacted):
<Attribute Name="groups">�Engineering;Platform</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="email">user@example.com</Attribute>
looks like either compression or utf-16/extra-null bytes.
ops: idp audit shows cert rotate + a toggled feature to compress large-group attributes. that should have been opt-in.
secbot: marking SEV-2 and scanning decompress libs for CVEs. KMS logs show no decrypt errors (pre-kms problem).
kai: hypothesis: gateway base64-decodes then hands bytes directly to xml parser expecting utf-8. if idp sent gzipped or utf-16 bytes, parser yields nulls and our csv-split on groups fails -> empty group list -> RBAC strip.
jen: quick mitigations: 1) ask idp to disable compressed attrs for our tenants immediately; 2) add gateway detect for gzip magic (0x1f8b) after decode and inflate; 3) add charset-autodetect+transcode fallback (utf-16 => utf-8); 4) WAF rule alert-only for embedded nulls.
ops: WAF rule in alert-only now. no noisy alerts so far.
micah: i'll open a gateway PR for gzip detection + charset transcode + metric + structured audit field malformed_assertion=true.
secbot: require audit entries for any provisioning events that removed roles; export to sec-analytics and create support tickets for impacted users. retention request: 90 days for these entries.
deploy-bot: gateway v3.2-canary with gzip-detect deployed 2026-03-23T04:20Z to canary. monitoring.
ops: canary telemetry shows SCIM 400s drop ~80%. scheduling prod deploy +30m if stable.
jen: after prod rollout, run RBAC reconcile/backfill for affected tenants and produce count of impacted users. i'll draft postmortem with root cause: idp compression opt-in + gateway missing autodetect.
kai: add unit tests and a fuzzer for malformed attr payloads to prevent regressions.
micah: action items: micah PR + tests, ops prod deploy, jen reconcile & postmortem, secbot vuln follow-up. closing for now; will update when reconcile numbers in.
